verses.1: And Jehovah commanded Sarah to do as He had said. Thus, Jehovah did what He had commanded.
verses.2: And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Abraham, in accordance with the time that God had decreed.
verses.3: And Abraham called the name of his son, who was born to him, Isaac.
verses.4: And Abraham commanded his son Isaac to do what God had commanded him.
verses.5: And Abraham, the son of Meth, was born when he was one year old. Then Isaac was born to him.
verses.6: And Sarah said, “God has done for me all that I desire.” All those who hear this will laugh at me.
verses.7: And she said, “Who can say to Abraham that his sons will be circumcised? After all, I was born as a son of his old age.”
verses.8: And the child grew up. Abraham prepared a great feast on the day he circumcised Isaac.
verses.9: And Sarah saw the son of the Egyptian man who had given birth to Abraham, and he was a beautiful child.
verses.10: And she said to Abraham, “Sacrifice this daughter as well. For she will not inherit anything from her father with my son Isaac.”
verses.11: And it became a great disaster in Abraham’s eyes, because of his son’s actions.
verses.12: And God said to Abraham, “Do not be afraid in your eyes about the boy and your wife, for all that Sarah says to you, listen to her. For in Isaac you will be called a descendant of Abraham.”
verses.13: And also the son of the amah, we will exile him into a foreign land, because your descendants are the ones who caused this.
verses.14: And Abraham set them up in the morning. He took bread and some water, and he gave them to the woman. Then he sent her away. She went and wandered in the wilderness for forty years.
verses.15: And the waters became too hot. So they threw the baby into one of the trees.
verses.16: And she went and sat down opposite him, as if in the corner of a wall. For she said, “I will not see the child dead.” Then she sat down and cried out loudly.
verses.17: And God heard the boy’s voice. He called out to the angel from heaven, saying, “What are you doing here, angel? Do not be afraid. For God has heard the boy’s voice when he was there.”
verses.18: Come, take the boy and hold your hand over him, as if he were a great nation. We will curse you.
verses.19: And God opened her eyes. She saw a sea ahead of her. She walked along the surface of the water, filling it with heat from the sea. Then she cooled down the child.
verses.20: And God made the boy great. He settled him in the wilderness, and he became very strong.
verses.21: And he settled in the land of Paran. Then his mother, a woman from Egypt, took him there.
verses.22: And at that time, Abimelech said to the chief priest, “God will be with you in all that you do.”
verses.23: And now, I ask God: will you deceive me, my children, and my descendants, like the kindness that I have shown to you? Will you do the same to me and to this land where we live?
verses.24: And Abraham said, “I will do it.”
verses.25: And Abraham avenged Abimelech by killing those who had stolen the women from Abimelech’s servants.
verses.26: And Abimelech said, “I did not know who did this. You also did not tell me, and I did not hear about it either.”
verses.27: And Abraham took some sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. They made a covenant with each other.
verses.28: And Abraham set aside seven bundles of sheep for himself.
verses.29: And Abimelech said to Abraham, “What are these seven pillars that you have built for Baal?”
verses.30: And he said, “I will take seven of them from my hand. They will be a reminder for me, since I have hoarded this oil.”
verses.31: Therefore, it was called that place “Eir Shavva”, because there they were blessed together.
verses.32: And they made a covenant in the Valley of Sheba. Abimelech became king over his army, and they returned to the land of Israel.
verses.33: And he planted trees in the land of Seba. He named that place “Yehovah El Olam”.
verses.34: And Abraham lived in the land of Canaan for many days.
